tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Find vacation rentals listed by their owners that are booked directly on the owner's own website (no platform fees). Filter by place, dates, guests, pets and nightly price. With checkIn and checkOut, only stays open for those dates are returned. Returns up to 25 stays with photo, price, owner-report

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: Full details for one stay: description, amenities, beds and baths, photos, approximate location, host name, owner-reported ratings, links to the same home on Airbnb/Vrbo when the owner lists them, and when its calendar last synced.

tools.name: check_dates
tools.description: Whether one stay is open for a check-in/check-out window, from the owner's own calendars (synced about every 30 minutes). When the dates are taken, returns up to three nearby open windows of the same length. If the owner has not connected a calendar, available is null: the dates are unknown, not ope

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: The link to book a stay on the owner's own website, where the guest books and pays the owner directly. Guest2Host takes no fee and never handles payment. Optional dates and guests are passed along for reference.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: The destinations Guest2Host has stays in, with how many stays each has.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send a traveler's question to the owner of a stay by email, for example about early check-in or a longer stay. The owner replies to the traveler's email directly. Use only with the traveler's name, email and question, and only after they have agreed to send it. This does not book or hold the dates.

tools.name: apply_to_list
tools.description: For owners: apply to list a vacation rental on Guest2Host (free, no commission, never takes payments). Needs four things: the property name, its town and state, the owner's own booking-site link and the owner's email. The owner gets a confirmation email with a status link (also returned here); once

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_inquiry, apply_to_list · Public sink: check_dates, send_inquiry, apply_to_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_inquiry, apply_to_list · Public sink: check_dates, send_inquiry, apply_to_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
